$comment: Stale and unsafe Whop code. `literal` strings are banned from skill docs by scripts/validate.py; `regex` (JavaScript syntax) is what hooks/check-whop-code.mjs matches in code the agent writes. Every fix comes from skills/whop-migrate/references/legacy-map.md or a skill's Rules.

patterns.fix: `@whop/api` is deprecated and the public GraphQL API behind it stopped on October 26, 2026. Use `WhopClient` from `@whop/sdk`. For iframe user tokens, verify with `jose` as `whop-apps` shows.
`@whop/sdk` 2.x has no default export. Use `import { WhopClient } from "@whop/sdk"` (types: `import type { Whop } from "@whop/sdk"`).
The client is `new WhopClient({ token })`.
`WhopClient` takes `token`, not `apiKey`: `new WhopClient({ token: process.env.WHOP_API_KEY })`.

Switch environments with `environment: WhopEnvironment.Sandbox` (Python `WhopEnvironment.SANDBOX`), not a base URL. A base URL override sends every request to one host and operations that need another host are refused.
Verify with `unwrapWebhook(rawBody, { headers, key })` from `@whop/sdk/helpers`, passing the `ws_...` secret unchanged.
Pass the webhook secret exactly as Whop gave it (`ws_...`). Never base64-encode it; `unwrapWebhook` derives the key itself.
Use `unwrapWebhook(rawBody, { headers, key })` from `@whop/sdk/helpers`.
Plans are variants: `client.variants.list/retrieve/create/update/delete` (variant IDs keep the `plan_` prefix). `plans.calculateTax` is `client.paymentQuotes.create`.
Companies are accounts: `client.accounts.retrieve/list/create/update`, and `client.accounts.me()` for your own.
`client.accounts.create({ email, title, metadata })` called with the platform's Account API key creates the account under that platform. There is no parent field.
Current API requests and filters take `account_id`, not `company_id` (a few Legacy-only resources still take `company_id`; follow the SDK type for that method).

Withdrawals are payouts: quote with `client.payouts.createQuote(...)`, then `client.payouts.create({ account_id, amount, payout_method_id, quote_token })` with an `Idempotency-Key`. `/withdrawals` list and create return `410`.
Top-ups are deposits: `client.deposits.create({ destination, amount })`.

Renamed: `ledgerAccounts` -> `accounts.retrieve` (read `balances`), `feeMarkups` -> `accounts.fees`, `payoutMethods` -> `payouts.methods`, `authorizedUsers` -> `teamMembers`, `socialAccounts` -> `externalAccounts`, `paymentMethodDomains` -> `domains`.
Charge a saved method with `client.payments.create({ member_id, payment_method_id, ... })`.
Send funds with `client.transfers.create({ type: "balance", amount, currency, origin_id, destination_id })` and an `Idempotency-Key`.
Checkout sessions are checkout configurations: `client.checkoutConfigurations.create(...)` returns `purchase_url`.
The account link use case is `account_onboarding`.
The account link use case is `payouts_portal`.
`plan_type` is `billing_type` (`one_time` or `renewal`); the filter `plan_types` is `billing_types`.
Use `client.memberships.extend({ id, days })`.
`membership.went_valid` is `membership.activated`; `membership.went_invalid` is `membership.updated` (read `previous_attributes.status`).
`membership.deactivated` still delivers but is no longer documented. Losing access arrives as `membership.updated` with `previous_attributes.status`.
Event names are dotted and live in `event.type`: `payment.succeeded`, `membership.activated`, `membership.updated`, `refund.created`, `dispute.created`.
Payout events are `payout.created`, `payout.updated` and `payout.reversed`. There is no `payout.completed`; check `payout.updated` with `status: "completed"`.
Use the Current API at `https://api.whop.com/api/v1` (same API keys). API v2 stops working on November 13, 2026; public GraphQL stopped on October 26, 2026.
The `/sse` endpoint is retired. Use `https://mcp.whop.com/mcp`.
Embed checkout with `Checkout` + `CheckoutElement` from `@whop/elements-react` (or `loadWhop` from `@whop/elements`).
Payout and KYC components moved to `@whop/elements-react` / `@whop/elements` (for example `Verifications` + `KycElement`). Only chat still uses `@whop/embedded-components-*`.
Whop API amounts are in dollars (major currency units): `initial_price: 10.0` is $10.00, so don't multiply by 100. (Elements `amount` props are the exception: they take minor units.)
This prefix bundles the value into browser or mobile code. Whop API keys and webhook secrets stay on the server: name it `WHOP_API_KEY` / `WHOP_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and read it only in server code.
This is a client component, so the key would ship to the browser. Call Whop from a server route or server action and have the client call that.
Don't commit the webhook secret. Read it from `process.env.WHOP_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

Verify the raw body (`await request.text()`; in Express mount the webhook route with a raw-body parser instead of `express.json()`). A parsed or re-serialized body changes the bytes and every signature check fails.
